title: Director Care & Clinics Marketing
description:
Light is building the financial foundation for businesses operating across entities and currencies, with AI agents doing routine work and people shaping how the system operates. Our ambition is to become the operating layer for entire industries. Care Homes and Clinics are part of our priority verticals.

We’re looking for a Director Care & Clinics Marketing to build our position in these markets as part of a world-class vertical marketing team. You’ll combine deep customer understanding, a clear industry point of view and commercial judgement to turn an opportunity into a repeatable way to win.

You’ll own market understanding, positioning and the marketing pipeline for Care Homes and Clinics, partnering closely with the Care Sales Manager and Clinics Sales Manager and our shared Product Marketing, Demand Generation and Field Marketing teams.

 

What you’ll do

  • Understand the market and choose where to focus. Interview customers and specialist partners to uncover buying triggers, workflows and unmet needs. Build a shared segment plan with Sales, testing opportunities among groups operating multiple care homes, clinics or practices.

  • Define the proposition. Turn customer insight into clear positioning, competitive arguments and a credible industry point of view. Work with Product Marketing to create customer stories, demonstrations and sales kits that show why Light matters to each segment.

  • Own the marketing pipeline. Build the model, set campaign priorities and lead execution with Demand Generation and Field Marketing. Own weekly reporting on qualified opportunities, conversion and progress against pipeline targets, with clear actions when performance falls short.

  • Make AI part of the operating rhythm. Use AI for research, campaign execution and reporting that gets to the why behind the numbers. Investigate what drives conversion and where deals stall, validate the findings with customer and Sales evidence, and turn them into decisions.

  • Be a true partner to Sales. Train direct sales reps and SDRs on the nuances of Care Homes and Clinics: their buyers, language, workflows and objections. Join important customer conversations and equip the team with the insight and proof needed to move deals forward.

  • Build credibility in the sector. Speak at conferences, webinars and industry discussions. Develop relationships with the press, analysts, influencers and specialist partners who shape how buyers think, bringing a useful perspective grounded in customer experience.

  • Bring the customer voice into the product. Partner with Product Marketing to define the workflows, integrations and product requirements critical to these sectors. Work with Product and customer teams to prioritise needs based on evidence and keep market promises grounded in what Light can deliver.

  • Turn early wins into a repeatable approach. Build customer relationships, lead interviews and capture outcomes that become references and case studies. Use win/loss learning to sharpen our targeting, message and campaigns.

 

What you’ll bring

  • Around ten years of marketing experience, with a strong foundation in industry or product marketing and evidence of building markets and delivering commercial results.

  • Experience owning a marketing pipeline from planning through execution and reporting. You can build a model, understand funnel performance and explain what needs to change.

  • An established ability to speak publicly and tell a compelling industry story, whether on stage, in a customer interview or in conversation with the press, analysts and influencers.

  • Experience working with specialist partners and building trusted relationships within Care Homes, Clinics or a closely related sector.

  • A record of partnering closely with Sales, including training direct reps and SDRs to understand a segment and sell into it with credibility.

  • Experience translating customer needs into clear sector requirements with Product Marketing and Product, distinguishing a recurring market need from a one-off request.

  • Strong analytical curiosity and practical experience using AI to investigate performance, test explanations and improve decisions. You verify the output and can explain the reasoning behind your recommendations.

  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, the judgement to challenge assumptions, and a willingness to do the work yourself: interview customers, write the message, build the campaign and examine the results.

  • You’ll bring enough sector understanding to earn credibility quickly, alongside the curiosity to keep learning. We’re looking for someone who can build a market and a repeatable approach, with customer evidence behind both.

 

What success looks like

Clear priorities for Care Homes and Clinics, positioning that resonates with buyers, and a growing marketing pipeline. Weekly reporting explains what is happening, why it is happening and what the team will do next.

Sales reps and SDRs understand the nuances of each segment and have the training, content and customer proof to progress deals. Customers and specialist partners strengthen our presence in the market, while Product Marketing and Product have a clear, evidence-backed view of the requirements that matter most.

You’ll assess progress through qualified pipeline, conversion, sales-cycle performance and customer outcomes, working with Sales and customer teams to understand delivery effort and time to value.

 

How we work

Light’s values are speed, simplicity and transparency. We make decisions when the evidence is sufficient, keep ownership clear and share progress and problems early. We expect leaders to raise the quality of the work, help colleagues succeed and use AI to remove unnecessary effort.

This is an opportunity to shape a priority market from the beginning, with direct influence on how Light understands customers, takes its product to market and develops its offering.

 

The good stuff

🏢 In-office, five days a week, high talent density.
💸 Competitive salary.
🏝 25 days annual leave plus public holidays.
🚀 Define what winning looks like in a vertical from the very first deal.
🌍 Regular travel to Copenhagen, Munich, NY, Paris, and wherever Care Homes & Clinics actually do business.
🥳 Off-sites twice a year. The last one was in Italy.

 

How to apply

Tell us about a specialist market you helped grow: how you built the pipeline, earned credibility with customers and partners, and equipped Sales to win. Share a time your analysis changed the plan, and how customer insight shaped a product requirement.

description:
Hi 👋 I'm Chris. I'm a Lead Product Marketing Manager at hx - I joined over four years ago as a Product Marketing Manager. Outside of work you'll find me playing sport (badly), watching reality TV, or taking my dog Lucky to the park (or the pub!).

Product Marketing at hx is a highly strategic function. We shape the company's positioning and messaging, decide where and when products launch, and build the process that gets them to market.

This role comes with deep ownership over how we address our core audience: actuaries. You’ll need to go deep into the life and workflow of highly technical users and develop messaging, positioning, and content that neatly conveys the benefits of our solution.

You'll need to be comfortable managing senior stakeholders and have great taste - but what matters most is drive, and a willingness to solve problems as you find them. In return, you'll join a team that's kind, supportive, and full of very smart people who want to go fast and far. If that sounds like you, read on!

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the team

Marketing at hx operates at the intersection of demand generation, systems thinking, and constrained markets. We build authority and demand in a highly technical, niche space where every account matters. This isn't template-driven volume work - it's deep, strategic B2B marketing crafted for a known universe of accounts, and we stay involved from first engagement through to customer success.

As Product Marketing Manager for Calculation Engines and Portfolio Intelligence, you'll sit at the heart of how hx becomes the obvious choice for actuaries who want to price faster and steer their portfolio with confidence. You'll own the technical story for our developer community - the most demanding audience we serve - and be the connective tissue between Product, Revenue, and the AI team, turning user insight into sharp positioning, useful sales assets, and narratives that stand up to scrutiny from people who'll know immediately if they don't. Your work spans two distinct challenges at once: deepening engagement and value realisation for our established Calculation Engines product, whilst driving launch readiness, early adoption, and strong feedback loops for Portfolio Intelligence.

The team experiments constantly, uses AI to focus on strategy over busy work, and operates with a high bar for quality and pace. You'll be joining a group that takes work seriously but not themselves, where compressed learning is the norm and the most future-ready in your craft is the standard.

Check out our Marketing & GTM Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!

What you'll be doing

Drive deeper engagement and adoption of Calculation Engines among existing users, using the usage data we now have to spot where users stall and creating messaging and enablement that moves them forward.

Own go-to-market execution for the Portfolio Intelligence release end to end - positioning, launch materials, enablement, and user communications that get it in front of the right people and drive real usage.

Accelerate early adoption of Portfolio Intelligence by creating onboarding support and launch assets that help target users get to first value quickly, evidenced by users moving out of the beta programme into sustained use.

Become the developer community's champion by writing technical content at a regular cadence that Solutions Engineering uses in live deals, and answering architecture and integration questions directly rather than routing them to Product.

Build hx's position in actuarial AI by developing differentiated positioning and up-to-date competitive understanding that works consistently across website copy, enablement, and customer conversations.

Establish strong feedback loops between users, Product, Revenue, and the AI team, so insight from launches, testing, and field conversations directly informs messaging, prioritisation, and product direction.

What you'll need to have done

Led product marketing in a B2B SaaS environment, balancing adoption work for an existing product with launch readiness for a new one at the same time - demonstrating commercial judgement across multiple GTM motions.

Increased engagement or adoption of a mature product by using user insight to sharpen messaging or enablement - with measurable improvement in usage, understanding, or qualitative feedback from users and revenue teams.

Owned a product launch end to end, including the internal readiness and enablement work that happens before it ships - not just the moment it goes out.

Turned a complex technical capability into credible, differentiated messaging for a skeptical, technical audience - developers or an equivalent evaluator population - built on real user insight rather than generic claims.

Worked hands-on alongside a Solutions Engineer or equivalent technical partner, comfortable being challenged on technical detail and holding your line, and earning trust across Product, Engineering, and Revenue without relying on formal authority.

Used AI with real judgement about when a technical claim is actually true rather than just plausible, and applied that judgement to rebuild how systems like enablement, competitive intelligence, or win/loss work - not just run them faster.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • You expect full product maturity, clear roadmaps, and well-defined processes before taking action - hx moves fast and requires comfort operating in ambiguity where products, priorities, and messaging are still evolving.

  • You focus primarily on flashy launch work or brand campaigns rather than the detail-oriented, outcomes-driven work of deepening adoption, engagement, and user understanding.

  • You struggle to prioritise or make trade-offs without perfect information, waiting for others to decide rather than using judgment to move work forward with the context available.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)

  6. We offer!

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Runa is pioneering a first-of-its-kind payment rail that enables the seamless, global money movement at scale. Legacy banking and payment infrastructure struggles to support the demands of today's low-volume, high-velocity payouts, leading to inefficiencies in global payouts. Businesses worldwide send over $20 trillion annually in rewards, remittances, and disbursements often incurring costs of up to 50% per transaction and subjecting recipients to lengthy delays.

Runa transforms this landscape by providing a new digital payments infrastructure that empowers businesses to send digital money instantly and cost-free to anyone, anywhere. deskbird is one of Europe's fastest-growing workplace-management platforms – a SaaS success story serving hundreds of enterprise customers and building the operating system for the workplace of the future, well past €10M ARR and scaling with an efficiency-driven playbook. In 2025 we closed a funding round led by Octopus Ventures, with co-investments from NEVA SGR (Intesa Sanpaolo Bank) and AVP, and participation from Alstin Capital, session, and Portfolion.

You'll join a small, talented, highly ambitious executive team – and the equity package is designed so that when we win, you win meaningfully.


If you are passionate about creating enterprise value, scaling finance organizations, and owning the story you used to analyze – this is that seat.



In this role you will

  1. The equity story and funding readiness. You will keep deskbird in the best possible shape for whatever comes next - future financing rounds, strategic options, and long-term value creation. Narrative, metrics, data room, diligence readiness: always current, always credible. When we choose to run a process, you will lead it, working directly with the founders and board.

  2. The path to profitability. You’ll own the plan that takes us to sustainable positive cash flows profitability without sacrificing growth: driver-based planning, disciplined capital allocation, and a sharp view on where every franc and euro works hardest.

  3. An AI-first finance & operations function. We want a hands-on operator on the edge of AI development who automates before hiring, works in the models and tools personally, and proves that a lean, AI-augmented team can outperform a traditional org several times its size. We don’t want a CFO who builds a 20-person department.

  4. Commercial intelligence for GTM and Product. You’ll drive the insights that tell us where to invest: which segments, motions, and product bets deliver the strongest combined growth and efficiency profile. Finance at deskbird is a value driver in pricing, packaging, NRR economics, and unit-economics decisions - not just a scorekeeper.

  5. International structure and tax efficiency. You’ll own our multi-entity group structure across Europe, introduce transfer pricing, and ensure we operate in a tax-efficient, fully compliant setup as we scale internationally.

  6. The cap table and investor-grade financials. You’ll keep our cap table and VSOP clean, well-modeled, and always ready for the next financing round, and bring our accounting to the  standard any institutional investor expects - SaaS revenue recognition (local GAAP) done right, smooth statutory audits, and, where a future process demands it, conversion to the relevant GAAP.

  7. Board and investor relations. You’ll run the reporting rhythm, build trust with our existing investors, and represent deskbird credibly to future ones - from day one, alongside the founders.

  8. Cash, risk, and the operational backbone. Treasury, FX, and runway discipline, scenario planning, audit readiness, and oversight of legal, procurement, and insurance.



What you need to be successful

Full working proficiency in English; German is strongly preferred.
Nice to have

title: Customer Support Executive
description:
About The Alliance

When it comes to building world-class professional communities, The Alliance is leading the way. From Product Marketing and Sales Enablement to Product-Led Growth, AI, Customer Success, and CMOs, we're home to some of the most engaged and influential communities in the industry.

With 160,000+ professionals across our communities and a constant stream of content, courses, events, and memberships, we help our members learn, connect, and grow. Our executive events are a key part of that mission—bringing together senior leaders to share insights, tackle industry challenges, and build meaningful relationships.

Every year, we engage attendees, speakers, partners, and members from some of the world's leading organisations and fastest-growing start-ups, including TikTok, Microsoft, Peloton, and Uber.

 

The Role

We are on look out for a detail-driven, proactive Customer Support Executive to join our vibrant Customer Success team. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact across our support channels, elevating the overall member experience by resolving queries and ensuring our users maximize the value of our platform.
Beyond day-to-day support, you will spearhead forward-looking initiatives designed to preemptively address customer needs, such as optimizing our AI support agent, analyzing key pain points, and building expertise in customer operations within a fast-growing, collaborative environment.

Responsibilities

  • Customer Support Champion: Be the first line of contact for our members via email and our ticketing system, providing timely, friendly, and helpful responses every day.

  • Escalation Pro: Spot the difference between a quick fix and something that needs a deeper dive, escalating where appropriate to keep things moving smoothly.

  • Priority Pro: Keep a clear head and a clean inbox, staying organised across multiple tickets, deadlines, and internal priorities.

  • AI Agent Champion: Support the ongoing maintenance, development, and continuous improvement of our AI agent, helping to refine its responses, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure it continues to deliver a great experience for our members when we’re not around.

  • Internal Collaborator: Work closely with Customer Success, Education, Product and other departments to resolve member issues quickly and efficiently.

  • Process Improver: Contribute to FAQs, support documentation, and internal feedback loops to make us even better, every day.

  • Platform Power User: Use Intercom to manage tickets and feed back customer experience improvements to the wider team.

Compensation: £32,000-34,000 base Salary (depending on experience)

Location: this role can be Remote from wherever in the UK or hybrid in our London office.

This role is for you if you:

  • Have excellent written communication skills and a calm, customer-first approach.

  • Have experience with Intercom, Zendesk or similar support platforms (ideally including experience working with AI agents)

  • Are forward thinking, detail-oriented and take pride in getting the small things right.

  • Know when to escalate, and when to troubleshoot.

  • Strong communicator - from our customers to your colleagues, you’ll be working very closely with lots of people.

  • Team player - success doesn’t happen in a vacuum, we need everyone in the org to be rallied around the same goals and helping each other out to achieve them.

  • Creative problem-solver - we know that processes can always be improved. We’re looking for someone who can think on their feet, solve problems, and identify opportunities.

  • Tech-savvy - we lean on lots of different apps and while we’ll obviously onboard you on each, we’re looking for a quick learner who can show us a thing or two. We’re especially interested in your experience with Customer Support AI and Knowledge Database management.

 

Benefits: We believe exceptional people deserve exceptional support.

Time Off:

  • 34 days' annual leave, including UK Bank Holidays.

  • Your birthday is off every year.

 

Health & Wellbeing:

  • Enhanced family policies.

  • Private Medical Insurance.

  • Life Insurance (4x salary).

  • On-demand therapy, coaching, and mental fitness support through Oliva.

  • Heavily subsidised gym membership via Wellness Hub.

  • Cycle to Work and Workplace Nursery schemes.

 

Flexibility:

  • Flexible working hours, allowing you to work when you are most productive.

  • Monthly allowance via ThanksBen (£600 annually in year one, increasing with tenure).

 

Learning & Development:

  • Personal L&D budget (£500 annually in year one, increasing with tenure).

  • Four paid Learning & Development or Volunteer Days each year.

  • Team training and development opportunities.

 

Equipment & Culture

  • New tech setup including laptop, screen, mouse, and keyboard.

  • Company social events.

  • A collaborative, ambitious, and supportive working environment.

 

Community & Inclusion

At The Alliance, we're committed to creating a workplace that is free from discrimination and bias, where everyone has equal opportunities to succeed and contribute.

We know our work here is never done, and we continue to strive for a more inclusive environment every day.

 

If you're worried you don't meet every requirement listed, don't let that stop you from applying. Unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are essential to our ability to innovate and grow, so if you think you'd be a great fit, we'd love to hear from you.

 

We are The Alliance—in more ways than one.

Compensation: £32K – £34K

description:
Agent d’Exploitation Polyvalent (Editions)

Rejoignez-nous dans notre mission visant à transformer la façon dont les gens achètent et mangent, où l'impact, l'innovation et la croissance motivent tout ce que nous faisons. Notre équipe Commerciale est au cœur de la marketplace de Deliveroo : elle façonne la manière dont nous servons les restaurants, les commerçants et les nouveaux secteurs à travers le monde. De la négociation de partenariats clés au déblocage de nouvelles sources de revenus, en passant par l'élaboration de stratégies de croissance basées sur les données, nous relevons des défis majeurs qui font progresser l'entreprise. Si vous aimez les environnements commerciaux dynamiques et que vous souhaitez influencer l'avenir d'une marque mondiale, cette équipe est faite pour vous.

Nous recherchons un(e) Employé(e) Polyvalent(e) CDI - 35H pour rejoindre notre équipe à ST Ouen. Dans ce rôle, vous aiderez à maintenir le flux fluide de nos cuisines réservées à la livraison "Editions", en veillant à ce que chaque commande parvienne au client de manière parfaite et dans les délais.

 

Ce que vous ferez

Vous rejoindrez l'équipe Editions. Nos sites Editions sont des hubs dédiés exclusivement à la livraison qui permettent aux meilleurs restaurants de se développer dans de nouvelles zones. En tant qu'Agent d'Exploitation, vous êtes le cœur du site, coordonnant les partenaires en cuisine, les livreurs et les clients pour garantir l'excellence opérationnelle.

Voici un aperçu de votre quotidien :

  • Gérer le Dispatch : Superviser la remise rapide des plats aux livreurs tout en résolvant proactivement les problèmes en direct entre les cuisines et les partenaires.

  • Garantir la Sécurité Alimentaire : Réaliser les contrôles HACCP et de sécurité quotidiens, en veillant à ce que nos normes élevées d'hygiène alimentaire et de sécurité du site ne soient jamais compromises.

  • Résoudre les Problèmes en Temps Réel : Être le premier point de contact pour les réclamations clients, en utilisant nos processus internes pour garantir un parcours client réussi.

  • Viser l'Excellence du Site : Collaborer étroitement avec le Site Manager et l'Assistant Manager pour atteindre les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et maintenir un service de haute qualité.

  • Piloter le Terrain : Assurer les procédures d'ouverture et de fermeture, en faisant preuve de la polyvalence nécessaire pour assumer tous les rôles sur le site selon les besoins.

Ce dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir

Essentiel :

  • Forte capacité de polyvalence : Aptitude avérée à gérer des volumes importants d'informations et à jongler avec plusieurs défis opérationnels simultanément.

  • Excellente communication : Compétences claires et efficaces à l'oral comme à l'écrit pour assurer la liaison avec les partenaires et les clients.

  • Esprit d'initiative : Une mentalité proactive avec une capacité démontrée à anticiper les besoins et à agir de manière autonome.

  • Sens de la sécurité : Une solide compréhension (ou une volonté de devenir référent) des normes de sécurité alimentaire et HACCP.

Souhaité :

  • Expérience en restauration : Une première expérience opérationnelle dans un environnement de cuisine ou de restaurant.

  • Certifications de sécurité : Formation en premiers secours, sécurité incendie ou sécurité alimentaire (bien qu'une formation puisse être dispensée).

  • Compétences linguistiques : La maîtrise de l'anglais est un plus pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Chez Deliveroo, vous ferez un travail qui compte, en résolvant des problèmes concrets dans une marketplace tripartite en constante évolution. Nous sommes des passionnés de cuisine, des solveurs de problèmes et des créateurs de liens, unis par une volonté commune d'améliorer les choses. En travaillant ici, vous pouvez vous attendre à :

🔧 Avoir un impact visible chaque jour Votre travail améliore directement l'expérience des clients, des partenaires et des livreurs.

🌱 Apprendre vite dans un environnement entrepreneurial Travaillez au plus près du marché avec autonomie, rapidité et de réelles responsabilités.

🧠 Construire une carrière, pas seulement un poste Dépassez-vous, développez de nouvelles compétences et évoluez en même temps que l'entreprise.

🌎 Réussir ensemble dans une culture inclusive Des équipes collaboratives et guidées par des valeurs, qui soutiennent votre façon de travailler.

Nous visons à créer un processus équitable qui laisse briller vos compétences — notre parcours de recrutement comprend généralement 3 à 4 étapes. Pour en savoir plus sur notre façon de recruter, cliquez ici.

Notre structure mondiale

Deliveroo fait désormais partie de DoorDash, réunissant des équipes avec une portée, une échelle et une ambition encore plus grandes. Selon votre rôle, vous pourrez collaborer avec des collègues, des systèmes et des dirigeants à travers DoorDash et Wolt. Ensemble, nous débloquons de nouvelles possibilités en tant qu'équipe mondiale unique.

Diversité, Équité et Inclusion

Chez Deliveroo, nous savons qu'un lieu de travail exceptionnel reflète le monde qui nous entoure et que la diversité et l'inclusion nous rendent plus forts, plus créatifs et meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons. Nous nous engageons à favoriser un environnement où chacun peut donner le meilleur de lui-même et se sentir à sa place.

Nous croyons en l'égalité des chances et accueillons des candidats de tous horizons, quels que soient leur âge, leur sexe, leur origine ethnique, leur handicap, leur orientation sexuelle, leur identité de genre, leur milieu socio-économique, leur religion ou leurs convictions.

Si vous avez un handicap ou une condition de santé de longue durée et que vous avez besoin d'aide pour postuler, ou si vous avez besoin d'ajustements raisonnables pendant le processus de recrutement, veuillez contacter notre équipe de recrutement à ----- Nous serons ravis de vous aider pour vous garantir une expérience juste et équitable.

Si vous êtes enthousiaste à l'idée d'avoir un impact réel dans une marketplace en mouvement rapide et de développer votre carrière aux côtés d'équipes ambitieuses et solidaires, nous serions ravis de vous entendre !

Contrairement à une agence traditionnelle, Matera s'appuie sur l'innovation et l'automatisation pour être plus réactive et plus transparente, tout en laissant à chaque propriétaire la liberté de choisir son niveau d'implication.

Tu rejoins le pôle Mise en Location au sein de notre équipe Gestion Locative (une dizaine de collaborateurs).

Ton objectif est stratégique : garantir à nos bailleurs la meilleure expérience possible dès leur premier contact avec Matera, pour un onboarding fluide, rapide et sans accroc.

Accompagné·e par Elodie (Team Lead Mise en location), tu seras le premier point de contact opérationnel pour onboarder un nouveau client !

Tes missions :

  • Inviter et relancer les clients pour le paramétrage de leur.s bien.s sur leur espace Matera.

  • Vérifier les informations saisies et récupérer les documents manquants auprès du client.

  • Valider avec le client le bilan d'ouverture (soldes locataires, dépôt de garantie).

  • Réaliser les calls de kick-off et les calls relances.

  • Assurer le suivi administratif du dossier.

  • Nous aider à assurer le service et support clients : répondre aux questions et aider les clients et locataires dans leurs démarches, tout cela avec un maximum de dynamisme et de positivité pour offrir la meilleure expérience possible

  • Participer à la construction des process de l’équipe

Onboarding et montée en compétence :

Ton parcours d’intégration commence par deux semaines de rencontres avec l’ensemble de nos équipes pour comprendre comment nous sommes organisés en interne et notre vision. En parallèle, tu seras accompagné·e par ta manager et l’équipe sur des formations spécifiques au département Gestion Locative : formation sur les process de l’équipe, le fonctionnement de la plateforme, le traitement des demandes clients, etc.

À la fin de ton stage, tu sauras parfaitement piloter le suivi d’un dossier client de A à Z : de l’accompagnement des clients dans le paramétrage de leurs biens à la vérification des informations et documents, en passant par le suivi administratif, les échanges avec les clients et la gestion de leurs demandes. Le tout en contribuant à offrir une expérience client fluide, réactive et positive.

  • Tu as un excellent relationnel, tu es empathique, à l’écoute et à l’aise au téléphone,

  • Tu es rigoureux·se, avec une orthographe irréprochable,

  • Tu fais preuve de proactivité et d’un vrai sens du service client,

  • Tu es curieux·se, organisé·e et à l’aise dans un environnement tech,

  • Tu apprécies l’autonomie, la polyvalence et tu veux contribuer activement au développement d’une offre en plein essor.

Le processus de recrutement :

2️⃣ Rencontre avec Pauline, la manager de l’équipe et Elodie, ta future tutrice, pour une mise en situation (45 en visio) + Cas pratique

description:
Senior Product Designer

Didomi is looking for a Senior Product Designer to take end-to-end ownership of design across multiple products within our Privacy and Consent Management Platform. This is a senior IC role reporting directly to the Design Director, acting as design peer-lead within the Product team, supporting seven Product Managers and their engineering teams. Design is currently the one shared resource across the entire product org, and this role is central to how we scale it.

You'll help shape the future of our product, creating experiences that are intuitive, efficient, and user-centric, while collaborating closely with cross-functional partners. You'll get involved early, shaping problems alongside Product and Engineering rather than just executing against requirements handed to you, and take ownership of your workstreams once scope is assigned based on where the business needs it most.

What you'll do

  • Own the process end-to-end. Lead discovery through delivery for your assigned product areas, handing off finalized UX/functional design to our external creative agency for UI polish.
  • Shape decisions upstream. Get involved before requirements are locked, and bring evidence and clear rationale to engineering-first decisions rather than reacting after the fact.
  • Take ownership across ambiguity. Hold multiple complex workstreams and adapt as scope shifts with business priorities.
  • Build the research muscle. Help establish research and usability practices that don't fully exist today, and translate findings into decisions Product and Engineering can act on.
  • Reduce design debt. Flag and help prevent downstream friction from features shipping without a design pass.
  • Prototype fast with AI. Use tools like Figma Make or Claude to turn concepts into high-level, testable prototypes quickly, helping the team validate direction and unblock decisions without waiting on full design cycles for every idea.
  • Foster a strong design culture. Share knowledge, mentor peers, and help improve team processes.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in product/UX design, with real ownership of complex products and a strong portfolio of shipped work.
  • Fluency in Figma or equivalent design/prototyping tools.
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving, engineering-heavy environments with limited day-to-day oversight.
  • Strong interaction and systems thinking. You can untangle complex flows and design for edge cases.
  • Experience building or contributing to a research practice where formal resourcing is limited.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work efficiently with cross-functional teams.
  • Proven experience designing zero-to-one products, new platforms, or defining new product spaces.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (Figma Make, Claude, or similar) to generate high-level prototypes and accelerate concept validation.

Strongly preferred: experience in privacy, compliance, or another highly regulated/technical domain.

La mission porte sur le développement d’une batterie biodégradable au sodium pour dispositifs médicaux temporaires.

Le système sera entièrement composé de matériaux biorésorbables, avec une durée de vie ajustable. Cette recherche offrira une solution plus sûre pour alimenter les implants médicaux de courte durée.

Objectif stratégique du recrutement :

Renforcer les capacités de recherche du Département Bioélectronique avec un postdoctorant capable de développer une nouvelle génération de capteurs optiques organiques flexibles pour l’imagerie calcique.
Ce recrutement contribuera à faire progresser une technologie à fort potentiel à l’interface entre microélectronique, bioélectronique et neurosciences.

Missions principales :

o   Vous développez et micro-fabriquez des photodétecteurs organiques (OPD) flexibles miniaturisés destinés à la réalisation de matrices multipixels haute résolution.

o   Vous assurez la caractérisation électrique et optique de la plateforme OPD–FET dans des conditions d’illumination représentatives de l’imagerie calcique.

o   Vous analysez les performances des dispositifs afin d’optimiser leur intégration dans des matrices flexibles haute densité destinées à l’imagerie neuronale.

o   Vous valorisez vos travaux par des publications scientifiques et des communications internationales.

title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux - CDD de 18 mois
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris.

Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée.

Le projet proposé vise à développer et démontrer la prochaine génération de fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (HCPCF) pour la transmission de données à haut débit et les applications de détection. La propagation de la lumière dans l’air plutôt que dans le verre permet aux HCPCF d’offrir une latence réduite et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables par rapport aux fibres de silice, répondant ainsi à certains des enjeux majeurs des futurs centres de données et réseaux optiques. Notre ambition est de démontrer une transmission à 400 Gbit/s sur quelques kilomètres à travers des échantillons de fibres issus de nouvelles architectures, et d’étudier le potentiel de ces HCPCF pour des applications de détection. La réalisation de ces objectifs nécessite de répondre à des spécifications exigeantes en matière de guidage monomode, de contrôle de la polarisation, ainsi que de faibles pertes par courbure et par couplage.

Deux équipes complémentaires assureront conjointement l'encadrement de ces travaux : le GPPMM, reconnu internationalement pour ses activités de conception et de fabrication de HCPCF [3–5], et le GTO, leader dans la démonstration de systèmes de communication optique et de détection à haut débit [6–8]. Un processus itératif entre la fabrication des fibres et leur caractérisation au niveau système permettra de s'assurer que leurs propriétés répondent aux exigences opérationnelles en matière de transmission et de détection. Sur le plan méthodologique, le projet combinera modélisation numérique, caractérisation et validation expérimentale dans la bande C. Les méthodes de modélisation et de traitement du signal développées au GTO pour le suivi de la polarisation contribueront à évaluer et à optimiser les performances de transmission des HCPCF conçues et caractérisées au GPPMM.

À propos du projet PLEIADES

Le projet PLEIADES s'inscrit dans le cadre du programme PEPR « Réseaux du futur », financé par l'ANR, et réunit un consortium de 14 partenaires. L'un des axes de travail porte sur les fibres à cœur creux de nouvelle génération et rassemble plusieurs laboratoires académiques, notamment LTCI, XLIM et PHLAM.

Vos principales missions seront de :

  • Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de la photonique

  • Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat

title: Comercial de Software B2B | IA y Transformación Digital
description:
El Puesto

Serás responsable de impulsar el crecimiento comercial de nuestras soluciones ERP, software de gestión, movilidad, planificación, RR. HH. e Inteligencia Artificial en clientes nuevos y existentes. Trabajarás en un entorno B2B tecnológico, con ciclos de venta consultivos y clientes de tamaño medio y grande, colaborando estrechamente con los equipos de producto, consultoría, marketing y dirección.

Inteligencia Artificial: una parte importante de tu trabajo
En Freematica estamos incorporando la IA como una nueva capa de valor sobre nuestras soluciones y también como herramienta para transformar nuestra propia forma de trabajar.

Por ello, buscamos una persona que tenga interés real por la Inteligencia Artificial y sea capaz de incorporarla a su actividad comercial.

Utilizarás herramientas de IA para:

  • Mejorar la prospección y segmentación de cuentas
  • Preparar reuniones y analizar información de clientes
  • Identificar necesidades y oportunidades de negocio
  • Personalizar mensajes y propuestas comerciales
  • Analizar conversaciones, oportunidades y pipeline
  • Automatizar tareas comerciales y administrativas
  • Generar contenidos y argumentarios comerciales
  • Obtener insights a partir de datos y actividad comercial
  • Explorar nuevos casos de uso de IA aplicables a nuestros clientes y sectores
No buscamos necesariamente un perfil técnico de IA. Buscamos una persona con curiosidad, criterio y capacidad para entender cómo aplicar la tecnología y la IA para conseguir mejores resultados comerciales y aportar más valor al cliente.


Responsabilidades

  • Dominar rápidamente nuestro producto: comprender en profundidad nuestras soluciones, módulos, arquitectura básica y principales casos de uso para poder mantener conversaciones de valor tanto con perfiles de negocio como técnicos
  • Venta consultiva B2B: analizar los procesos, necesidades y retos del cliente, entender su modelo operativo y proponer la solución tecnológica que mejor responda a sus objetivos
  • Prospección y generación de negocio: identificar empresas objetivo, detectar oportunidades, realizar contactos iniciales, cualificar leads y desarrollar nuevas cuentas
  • Discovery y análisis de necesidades: preparar y dirigir reuniones de descubrimiento, identificar pain points, interlocutores, procesos, necesidades y criterios de decisión
  • Presentaciones y demos comerciales: presentar nuestras soluciones de forma orientada al negocio, adaptando el discurso a cada sector y perfil interlocutor
  • Diseño y seguimiento del proceso comercial: trabajar con un proceso estructurado y un pipeline definido: prospección → cualificación → discovery → demo → propuesta → negociación → cierre
  • Gestión rigurosa del CRM: mantener Salesforce actualizado, registrar actividad, próximos pasos, probabilidad de cierre, interlocutores y cualquier información relevante de las oportunidades
  • Forecast comercial: realizar previsiones de ventas rigurosas, identificar riesgos y mantener actualizado el estado real de cada oportunidad
  • Elaboración de propuestas a medida: coordinarte con los equipos de producto, consultoría y tecnología para transformar las necesidades detectadas en propuestas claras, viables y competitivas
  • Gestión de cuentas y crecimiento: detectar oportunidades de ampliación, nuevas soluciones, servicios y funcionalidades dentro de nuestra base instalada


Requisitos

  • Experiencia previa de 4-6 años o más en venta consultiva B2B de tecnología, preferiblemente en ERP, software de gestión empresarial, SaaS, Cloud, IT o soluciones digitales
  • Alta capacidad de aprendizaje técnico: comodidad trabajando con productos complejos y capacidad para traducir funcionalidades tecnológicas a beneficios de negocio
  • Experiencia en procesos de venta consultiva y ciclos comerciales B2B
  • Mentalidad de proceso y orientación a métricas
  • Experiencia trabajando con CRM (preferiblemente Salesforce), pipeline, forecast y metodologías comerciales estructuradas
  • Rigor en el seguimiento de oportunidades y reporting
  • Orientación a resultados y al cierre, manteniendo una visión de relación a largo plazo con el cliente
  • Capacidad para mantener conversaciones con diferentes interlocutores: dirección, operaciones, RR. HH., administración, IT, etc.
  • Autonomía y proactividad:
    • Capacidad para organizar tu agenda y priorizar cuentas
    • Iniciativa para generar oportunidades y abrir nuevas puertas
    • Capacidad para tomar decisiones y avanzar sin supervisión constante
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, presentación y negociación
  • Interés y conocimientos prácticos en Inteligencia Artificial y herramientas de productividad basadas en IA
  • Residencia en España y disponibilidad para desplazamientos puntuales a clientes y oficinas
Se valorará muy positivamente
  • Formación en áreas tecnológicas, empresariales o similares: Ingeniería, ADE, Economía, Informática, etc.
  • Experiencia previa en software empresarial, ERP o SaaS B2B
  • Experiencia en proyectos de transformación digital o implantación de soluciones de gestión
  • Conocimiento de los sectores de Limpieza, Facility, Seguridad, Servicios, Outsourcing o Instalaciones, o sectores con modelos operativos similares
  • Experiencia utilizando herramientas de IA generativa como ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude u otras herramientas similares aplicadas al trabajo diario
  • Conocimientos sobre automatización de procesos, agentes de IA, análisis de datos o aplicación de IA a procesos empresariales
  • Experiencia trabajando con equipos de Marketing y Product
  • Conocimiento de metodologías de venta consultiva y frameworks comerciales
  • Experiencia con Salesforce u otros CRM
  • Nivel de inglés suficiente para trabajar con documentación técnica y tecnológica


Tus ventajas

  • Incorporarte a una compañía sólida, con más de 28 años desarrollando software propio de gestión empresarial y una base estable de clientes en toda España
  • Trabajar con un producto tecnológico real, complejo y con un amplio recorrido de evolución
  • Participar en un momento especialmente interesante de transformación de nuestro producto, con el desarrollo de nuevas soluciones basadas en movilidad, automatización e Inteligencia Artificial
  • Formar parte de un equipo técnico y especializado donde tu opinión puede influir tanto en el producto como en la estrategia comercial
  • Oportunidad real de crecimiento profesional en el área comercial y de desarrollo de negocio
  • Entorno donde se valoran la iniciativa, la autonomía, el rigor y la capacidad de aportar
  • Acompañamiento inicial para que puedas conocer nuestro producto, nuestros sectores y nuestra metodología comercial
  • Condiciones competitivas acordes a la experiencia aportada, con fijo + variable por objetivos


Esperamos recibir su solicitud.

Más que un perfil que simplemente "venda software", buscamos a una persona que quiera convertirse en referente comercial de nuestras soluciones. Alguien capaz de sentarse con un cliente, entender cómo funciona su negocio, detectar dónde están sus problemas, explicar cómo puede ayudar la tecnología y construir una propuesta que tenga sentido tanto operativa como económicamente.Y, especialmente, alguien que entienda que la IA no es solo una tecnología más, sino una nueva forma de trabajar, vender y aportar valor a nuestros clientes.Si te motiva vender soluciones tecnológicas complejas, disfrutas entendiendo el negocio del cliente, tienes curiosidad por la tecnología y la IA y te gusta construir relaciones comerciales basadas en confianza, conocimiento y resultados, nos encantará conocerte.Envíanos tu CV y cuéntanos brevemente qué proyectos de venta consultiva tecnológica has liderado, qué tipo de soluciones has vendido y cómo estás utilizando actualmente la IA en tu trabajo.

Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are looking for an engaged and passionate Senior Data Engineer to join our growing Engineering Team. In this role, you will be a key member of the team managing our analytics and event platform stack.

As part of the Analytics & Data Platform team, you will build features for over 22,000 customers across the globe. Your work will unlock the value of data, empowering our customers to make informed decisions through real-time insights, monitoring, and comprehensive analytical reports.


Your role at Aircall
  • Have key responsibilities within the requirements analysis, scalable & low latency streaming platform solution design, architecture, and end-to-end delivery of key modules in order to provide near real-time data solutions for our product
  • Analyze and translate business needs into data model & optimize for big data
  • Identify slow queries and optimize for better performance
  • Write clean scalable code using Scala / python / SQL and test and deploy applications and systems
  • Solve our most challenging data problems, in near real-time, utilizing optimal data architectures, frameworks, query techniques, sourcing from structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Be part of an engineering organization delivering high quality, secure, and scalable solutions to Aircall clients
  • Involvement in product and platform performance optimization and live site monitoring
  • Mentor team members through giving and receiving actionable feedback.

    • Our tech. stack:
  • AWS (Kinesis,Kafka, s3, DMS, Glue, EMR, EKS, Redshift, Spectrum), Apache Pinot, Apache Flink and Airflow.
  • A continuous deployment process based on GitLab

    • A little more about you:
  • A Bachelor's degree in a technical field (eg. computer science or mathematics). 
  • 3+ years experience with near real-time analytics
  • 5+ years experience with a modern programming language such as Scala, Python, Go, Typescript
  • Experience of designing complex data processing pipeline
  • Experience of data modeling (star schema, dimensional modeling etc) in AWS redshift
  • Experience of query optimisation
  • Experience of kafka is a plus
  • Shipping and maintaining code in production
  • You like sharing your ideas, and you're open-minded
    •  
    Why join us?

    🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in term of growth and opportunities
    💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
    📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
    🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
    💶 Competitive salary package & benefits (health coverage, lunch, commute, sports)

    DE&I Statement: 
    At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion, irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations, are core to our Aircall journey. 
    We promote active inclusion to foster a strong sense of belonging which is one of our main strengths as a business. We strive to assemble diverse people that can enrich and learn from each other. We pledge to make sure everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued at the table -- providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.
    We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open because we realize that we have work to do and much to learn.

title: Onboard Software Engineer - Peripheral Services
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the Hub’s onboard computers, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit.

The Peripheral Services team owns the software that integrates third-party devices and payloads into Loft’s standardized satellite platform. We enable the control and monitoring of many key spacecraft components, including optical payloads, radios, power controllers, and GNSS receivers. Many of these components are reused across all satellite programs and form the building blocks of our onboard architecture.

The applications developed by our team handle the low-level communication protocol details, exposing the connected devices behind standardized APIs used across mission operations. The team is also responsible for the automation and orchestration that allows Loft to safely and reliably operate the equipment at scale.

In this role, you’ll help develop the software that connects diverse spacecraft hardware to the rest of the platform, and ultimately enables successful missions in orbit.


About this role:
  • Design, implement, and refine software with a high degree of ownership, driving impactful features from concept through delivery while ensuring robustness and reliability.
  • Review code, provide clear feedback, and enforce adherence to established development processes, style guides, and design standards to maintain consistency and quality across the codebase.
  • Design and implement unit and integration tests for both self-authored and peer-authored code.
  • Utilize version control systems to create feature branches, push code, and merge approved code into production branches.
  • Contribute to the onboard software architecture through design proposals and collaborative review
  • Participate in the review and enhancement of software development processes and design standards.
  • Coordinate with downstream teams on the distribution and adoption of the latest releases.
  • In addition to responsibilities within onboard software, you’ll have the opportunity to directly be involved in operating our on-orbit fleet of satellites.

Must Haves:
  • 3+ years' software engineering experience, using programming languages including C/C++ (C++11 or newer) and Python.
  • Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows
  • Experience with continuous integration tools (GitLab-CI, Jenkins, or similar).
  • Knowledge of build systems (e.g., Make, CMake).
  • Understanding of distributed architecture.
  • Familiarity with networking protocols (e.g., UDP, TCP, IP) and POSIX standards.
  • Experience in developing multi-threaded applications.
  • Previous team leader or manager role

Nice to Haves:
  • Familiarity with additional programming languages, such as Go or Rust.
  • Experience with embedded Linux operation, including Yocto, device trees, systemd, and Linux on ARM platforms.
  • Proficiency with unit test frameworks (e.g., pytest, Googletest, Unity)
  • Experience with middleware framework (gRPC, ZMQ/NATS, etc.)
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, K3S, systemd-nspawn)
  • Experience with space systems and concepts

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    •  *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

    Who We Are

    Loft: Space Made Simple. 

    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

title: Account Management Lead - Editions France
Client Enablement & Coaching Lead
description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

 

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

 

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do

  • Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement:

  • Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

  • Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

  • Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

  • Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

  • Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

 

Project Management:

  • Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

  • Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

  • Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

 

Mentorship & Coaching:

  • Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

  • Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

 

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

  • Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

  • Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

  • Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

  • Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

🤓 Lengow, une plateforme e-commerce intelligente et automatisée

Lengow est un acteur de référence des solutions e-commerce intelligentes qui permettent aux marques et aux retailers de générer une croissance rentable.

Grâce à une suite complète de solutions SaaS combinant gestion de flux produits, gestion des marketplaces, veille tarifaire concurrentielle et monitoring des réseaux de distribution, Lengow permet aux marques et aux retailers d’accroître la visibilité de leurs produits, d’affiner leur stratégie tarifaire, de développer leurs ventes sur les marketplaces et de mieux piloter leur réseau de distribution.

Depuis 2009, Lengow accompagne plus de 3 600 marques et revendeurs dans plus de 70 pays.

Rejoindre Lengow, c’est aussi évoluer dans un environnement international et multiculturel, au contact d’équipes aux profils variés, réparties notamment entre Nantes, Paris et Barcelone.

À propos de l’équipe IT interne

L’équipe IT interne de Lengow veille au bon fonctionnement et à la sécurité de l’environnement de travail de nos 150 collaborateurs répartis entre Nantes, Paris et Barcelone.

Elle est composée d’un(e) IT Manager, responsable de l’ensemble du périmètre IT interne, accompagné(e) d’un(e) alternant(e) Technicien(ne) Systèmes et Réseaux.

Notre environnement couvre notamment le support utilisateurs, la gestion du parc informatique, les systèmes et réseaux, la gestion des comptes et des accès, la sécurité et l’administration de nos outils internes.

L’équipe intervient dans un environnement multi-sites et multi-OS (Windows, macOS et Linux) et travaille à la fois sur les opérations IT du quotidien et sur des projets d’amélioration et de modernisation de notre environnement.

Cette alternance te permettra de développer une expérience concrète et polyvalente de l’IT interne, aux côtés de l’IT Manager. Tu monteras progressivement en compétences sur un périmètre IT varié, avec de plus en plus d’autonomie et de responsabilités, aussi bien sur les opérations du quotidien que sur des projets d’amélioration. 

Tu évolueras dans un environnement international, avec des collaborateurs présents sur plusieurs sites, à accompagner aussi bien sur place qu’à distance.

Systèmes, accès & réseaux

  • Contribuer à la documentation des procédures et de l’environnement IT

description:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

READ THIS PART FIRST

Legion is not a normal web application. It is command and control software that has to present dense real-time information, coordinate distributed systems, and continue being useful when communications are imperfect.

WHAT WE DO

Swarm Aero is redefining air power. We are building autonomous aircraft and Legion, command and control software designed to coordinate large numbers of heterogeneous autonomous systems. Our team combines experience building novel aircraft, scaling startups, and delivering technology for national security.

THE INTERNSHIP

You will own a scoped project with a clear technical or business outcome, work directly with the people responsible for the system, and present what you built and learned at the end of the summer. The goal is not to give you practice work. It is to give you useful work with the support to do it well.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

· Build product features across frontend, backend, full-stack, real-time, or forward-deployed software

· Develop interfaces for telemetry, geospatial data, mission planning, scheduling, collaboration, or system health

· Build and operate backend services, APIs, event-driven systems, or data pipelines

· Write automated tests, improve developer tooling, and help ship production-quality software

· Support integration and test events, debug issues across services and networks, and turn what you learn into product improvements

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

· Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related field, with graduation and enrollment requirements to be confirmed.

· Strong programming fundamentals and experience building a substantial software project

· Experience with a modern frontend framework, backend language, systems language, or full-stack application

· Ability to explain technical tradeoffs, debug methodically, and write maintainable code

WHAT SETS YOU APART

· React, TypeScript, Go, Python, Rust, C++, or similar tools

· Distributed systems, networking, real-time applications, maps, games, simulation, or data visualization

· Linux, Docker, CI/CD, customer-facing engineering, or deployed project experience

WHAT YOU DO NOT NEED

Aerospace experience, a perfect GPA, or a previous internship at a famous company. Show us what you have built, analyzed, tested, organized, or improved, and be ready to explain your contribution clearly.

THE HONEST VERSION

The pace is fast, the problems will not arrive fully defined, and you may spend part of the summer learning why your first approach was wrong. We will expect you to ask questions, test your assumptions, document your work, and leave the project better than you found it.

What We Offer

  • Medical, dental, vision, and 401k

  • PTO and paid sick leave

  • Monthly wellness stipend

  • Daily catered lunch (office)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Direct impact on a critical national security mission

  • A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems

title: Technical Sourcer
description:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

Read this part first

Somewhere out there is a sourcer who is better than their job title says they are. They hit their numbers at a company that never let them talk to a hiring manager. They found the candidate nobody else found and watched a recruiter take the credit. They have been told to be patient, to wait for the next cycle, to earn it.

We are not going to make you wait.

What we do

We build autonomous aircraft and Legion, the software that flies hundreds of them as one coordinated swarm. Series A, backed by Khosla Ventures, and Coatue. We are hiring software engineers and aircraft engineers at the same time, which is hard, and how fast we hire is one of the few things standing between the current aircraft and the next one.

That is not a motivational line. It is the actual constraint. Recruiting is on the critical path here, and you will be able to see your work in the flight schedule.

The job

You own top of funnel for our software engineering roles: backend, frontend, autonomy, forward deployed. You will be reading GitHub profiles, writing outreach that engineers answer, and building searches that keep producing after the obvious names are gone.

Then the interesting part. Inside your first year you move onto the aircraft side: propulsion, structures, avionics, manufacturing, production. Almost nobody sources both. The people who can are rare enough that it changes what your career looks like from that point forward. We will teach you, and you will be bad at it for a while, and then you will not be.

What you get here that you did not get there

  • Your own reqs, early, with your name on the outcome

  • Hiring managers in the same building, not behind an intake form

  • The freedom to change the message when it is not working, without asking three people first

  • Someone who runs sourcing searches themselves every day and will look at your search strings with you

  • A skill set at the end of two years that maybe a few hundred people in the country have

What we need from you

  • 1+ years of sourcing or recruiting, most of it in software engineering

  • A hire you are proud of, one nobody else was going to find, and the ability to walk us through exactly how you found them

  • A high tolerance for silence, because most of your outreach will go unanswered and the job is making the next message better anyway

  • Real curiosity about how aircraft get built, or at least the honesty to say you find it interesting and want in

  • Writing that sounds like a person, since your entire work product is text a stranger decides to open or delete

  • Clean data habits, because our reporting goes to the CEO and it needs to be right

What we do not need

Ten years of experience. A recruiting pedigree. A degree in anything specific. Permission from your current manager to be good at this.

The honest version

The pace is uncomfortable. You will be asked to fill roles you do not understand yet, and the answer will usually be to go learn them rather than to wait for a briefing.

If you want a clear ladder and a quiet quarter, this is the wrong job. If you have been waiting for someone to hand you something real, this is the shot.
